name: NVIDIA Rubin (VR200)

sources.title: NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 product page
ModulEdge: NVIDIA Vera Rubin for data center providers

summary: Rubin GPU with HBM4, used in the Vera Rubin NVL72 rack. Compute and memory are per-GPU shares of NVIDIA's published rack totals. Power is not published; the value is an estimate.

tdpW.note: Not published by NVIDIA. ModulEdge cites Ming-Chi Kuo: about 1.8 kW baseline, up to about 2.3 kW in the Max-P configuration. Value is the baseline; high is Max-P.

fp8Pflops.note: Dense. NVIDIA lists 1,260 PFLOPS FP8/FP6 training (dense) per 72-GPU rack: 1,260 / 72 = 17.5.

fp4Pflops.note: Dense. NVIDIA lists 2,520 PFLOPS NVFP4 training (dense) per 72-GPU rack: 2,520 / 72 = 35. The 3,600 PFLOPS inference figure is sparse (50 per GPU).

hbmGb.note: NVIDIA lists 20.7 TB HBM4 per 72-GPU rack: 20,700 / 72 = 287.5, rounded to 288.
